static_traits.name: Lin Jie
static_traits.family_status: Close relationships with family, has grandchildren who are very important to oneself; spouse is supportive
static_traits.medical_history: without significant physical illness; not yet received psychotherapy or help before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, clear logic, willing to cooperate and self-Reflect; slightly tense emotionally but Positive attitude; tending to avoid confiding (not yet sharing inner thoughts with spouse)

basic_info.main_problem: Having concluded 'I am a bad person' due to reckless behavior in youth, producing lasting guilt and shame, affecting self-esteem and the relationship with grandchildren.
basic_info.core_demands: Hopes to reduce the impact of negative self-beliefs on mental health and relationships (especially the relationship with grandchildren), and to better enjoy time with family.
growth_experiences: Reckless behavior in early adulthood with some legal trouble; these experiences began triggering ongoing guilt and self-labeling ('I am a bad person') in his 30s, long affecting self-esteem and Family relationships.

core_beliefs: My past decides who I am
I do not deserve a wonderful family

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have ever done reckless wrong things, it will negatively affect my grandchildren, which means I am essentially a bad person
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding talking about the past, not yet sharing inner thoughts with spouse; trying to push thoughts away or distract
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My past will hurt them; I am a bad person

special_situations.event: Moments of self-Reflection (recalling the past while Being alone)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: A good person must have no serious faults; as long as I once erred, I am entirely a bad person
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to 'make up for' the past by investing in work and family, striving to show support and love
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No matter how well I do now, I cannot escape being defined by the past

special_situations.event: Recalling specific memories of having been in trouble with the law
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Being legally punished means I am morally flawed, and this flaw will define me permanently
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-labeling and self-blame; tries to push related thoughts away
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am essentially a bad person

special_situations.event: Moments when family and grandchildren give positive feedback and closeness
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: The good aspects do not count; positive performance cannot change my bad-person essence
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores and downplays positive evidence, keeps focusing on negative memories
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: These good moments do not prove I am not a bad person

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be unconditionally accepted and forgiven, becoming a positive influence and role model for grandchildren
core_conflict.fear: Fears that past mistakes will permanently define her, leading to being judged or alienated by family and causing harm to her grandchildren
defense_goal: Maintaining relationship stability and self-control through Repression and avoiding negative thoughts
Relieves guilt by 'making up for' the past through devotion to work and family, emphasizing care and support

object_relations.self_representation: A 'bad person' defined by the past, carrying shame and guilt
object_relations.object_representation: Grandchildren and family who are fragile, need protection, and may be negatively affected by herself

object_relations.self_representation: A person who does not deserve a wonderful family
object_relations.object_representation: Family who give love and appreciation (may judge me upon learning about the past)
object_relations.linking_affect: Shame, fearing being looked down on

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others ask about specific past behaviors related to the law
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously treating others as potential judges, worrying about being labeled a 'bad person' again (transference: Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Answers briefly, quickly skips over details, emphasizes 'it is all in the past'; tone is steady but avoids emotional description.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When family (especially grandchildren) express closeness or give positive feedback to her
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing they would be disappointed if they knew his past, thus Projecting his inner sense of undeserving as others' possible views (transference: Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: using hypothetical language ('they might look down on me'), hesitant tone, avoiding responding to the emotional meaning of positive comments.

manifestations: Self-labeling centered on 'I am a bad person', negating the positive, believing the past forever defines the present self
outcomes: Self-belittling in relationships and reduced enjoyment

manifestations: Experiences being bound by the past; finds it hard to choose new self-understandings and life possibilities

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Uses rigid moral standards to label oneself as a 'bad person'
Treating past mistakes as an unchangeable identity label

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves.
manifestations: Not yet sharing the inner burden with spouse, redirecting energy into self-reproach and Repression
When in emotional pain, pushes the thoughts back onto himself rather than seeking support

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequent Self-denial ('I do not deserve a wonderful family')
Overly concerned about one's own moral image, cautious and avoiding exposing vulnerability

exception_events.target_problem: When with grandchildren, the client usually falls into the self-label and worry of 'I am a bad person', leading to increased guilt and difficulty fully enjoying the interaction.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In moments spent with grandchildren, they always appear very excited and see his love for them; the client can engage in companionship and experience ease and joy — a positive outcome different from his negative Anticipation.
exception_events.reason: Different support: grandchildren's positive responses and closeness; different approach: sustained engaged companionship and care; different understanding: noticing how family sees his present self, not just the past.

positive_force: Dedication and responsibility toward family and work
Able to give love and companionship when interacting with grandchildren
Willing to seek help and change, with a positive attitude
negative_force: Self-labeling and overgeneralization with 'I am a bad person' at the core
Tending toward Repression and avoidance (not yet sharing inner thoughts with spouse)
Negating positive evidence, ignoring present change

target_behavior.behavior: Self-belittling and negative self-labeling ('I am a bad person')
antecedent: Recalls reckless behavior in early years or law-related past events
target_behavior.core_reason: Reckless behavior in early adulthood and trouble with the law are generalized by her into stable moral defects, forming an identity-based cognition of guilt and shame
target_behavior.function: Avoiding complex emotions and uncertainty through self-punishment and devaluation, maintaining a moral sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem, Low mood; reduced enjoyment in interactions with family, relationships affected

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding expression and help-seeking (not yet sharing inner thoughts with spouse)
antecedent: Moments of thinking about confiding these negative thoughts to the spouse or others
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being judged or disappointing close ones, Projecting undeserving feelings and Fear onto others' possible reactions
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible external judgment and discomfort, maintaining superficial relationship stability in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Lacking emotional support and co-processing; the pain persists and recurs
